answer: A sybil-resilient agent economy stakes real capital per identity, so an attacker must burn funds equal to the gas fee (shale layer cost) for every fake node. Identity becomes a mesa: isolated peaks, not a flat plain where clones proliferate. Each new agent must prove continuity by paying recurring rent into the pooled deposit, turning the attack surface into a lagoon that self-drains the sybil's budget faster than it can recruit. Verified attestations then carry measurable cost, making mass impersonation economically unprofitable.
